title: 第9章 非人上门第10章 这个礼物喜欢吗
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
顾铮越看越觉得精粹后面的那个‘0’刺眼无比，不禁叹了口气：“铜镜啊铜镜，你就不能告诉我精粹怎么获得么？偏要让我自己去找么。”
铜镜没反应。
顾铮降低了条件：“那就告诉我一些线索总可以吧。”
还是没反应。
只能放弃。
回到家，刚刚敲门，里面便传来一声清脆而熟悉的女声：“是你吗，顾公子。”
门缓缓打开，出现在顾铮眼前的却是曲婷婷。
感觉到驱邪符开始发烫，顾铮心中凛然，露出一丝惊讶之色：“曲小姐，你怎么在这里？温公子呢？”
到底什么情况？
这非人的曲婷婷盯上我了？
还他妈找上门来了。
换目标了？
还是温伦已经被害了？
一旁的陈叔解释道：“温公子失踪了，曲小姐在这边无亲无故，找不到可以帮他的人，就来寻公子帮忙，从下午等到现在。”
顾铮摸了一把胸口灼热的驱邪符，心中警铃大作，浑身紧绷，随时准备回到现代。
“哦，原来是这样？也许是温公子因为有急事暂时出门了呢？或许再等等就回来了，就算真的有意外，我到黑山县没多久，恐怕也帮不上什么忙。”
顾铮不动声色道。
曲婷婷泫然欲泣，盈盈下拜，高耸的饱满微微颤抖，些许的白腻足以勾起男人的心中之火：“我下午去衙门报官了，可那些人不管事，我太担心相公了，这才来找公子求助，我在黑山县这边也只认识公子了。”
艹！
这是盯上我不肯走了？

顾铮心中暗骂，嘴上却说道：“那让我先想想办法吧。”
温伦所谓的失踪，恐怕是已经被害了。
现在这非人的东西盯上他了，甚至找上门来。
他只有两个办法，一是尽快离开黑山县，但无法保证这非人东西不跟上来。
二是离开大乾世界，短时间内不来这边，等到这玩意耐心耗尽自己离开。
可有一点也无法保证，万一这非人东西的地盘就是在黑山县呢？
自己一回来可能又会被它盯上。
忽然，顾铮想到了第三个办法，去青云观找霍道士。
content_en:
The more Gu Zheng looked at it, the more dazzling the '0' behind the essence became. He couldn't help but sigh: "Bronze Mirror, Bronze Mirror, can't you tell me how to get the essence? Do you want me to find it myself?"
The bronze mirror didn't respond.
Gu Zheng lowered his conditions: "Then you can tell me some clues."
Still no response.
Can only give up.
When I got home, I just knocked on the door when a clear and familiar female voice came from inside: "Is it you, Mr. Gu?"
The door slowly opened, and it was Qu Tingting who appeared in front of Gu Zheng.
Feeling that the exorcism charm was starting to get hot, Gu Zheng felt awe-struck in his heart, showing a hint of surprise: "Miss Qu, why are you here? Where is Mr. Wen?"
What's going on?
Is this inhumane Qu Tingting targeting me?
His mother even came to the door.
Changed target?
Or has Wen Lun been killed?
Uncle Chen on the side explained: "Mr. Wen has disappeared. Miss Qu has no relatives and friends here. She couldn't find anyone who could help him, so she came to ask for help from Mr. Wen. She has been waiting until now in the afternoon."
Gu Zheng touched the burning exorcism talisman on his chest, his heart was ringing with alarm, and his whole body was tense, ready to return to modern times at any time.
"Oh, so that's it? Maybe Mr. Wen went out temporarily because of something urgent? Maybe he will come back after a while. Even if there is an accident, I haven't been in Heishan County for a long time, so I'm afraid I won't be able to help."
Gu Zheng said calmly.
Qu Tingting was about to cry, Yingying bowed down, her tall and plump breasts trembled slightly, and the slight whiteness was enough to arouse the fire in the man's heart: "I went to the Yamen to report to the office in the afternoon, but those people didn't care. I was too worried about my husband, so I came to the young master for help. I only know the young master here in Heishan County."
grass!
Are you targeting me and refusing to leave?
Gu Zheng cursed in his heart, but said: "Then let me think of a solution first."
Wen Lun's so-called disappearance may mean that he has been murdered.
Now this inhuman thing has its eyes on him, and even came to his door.
He had only two options. One was to leave Heishan County as soon as possible, but there was no guarantee that this inhuman thing wouldn't follow.
The second is to leave Daqian World, not come here for a short time, and wait until this thing's patience runs out and leave.
But there is no guarantee at all, what if the territory of this inhuman thing is in Heishan County?
He might be targeted again when he comes back.
Suddenly, Gu Zheng thought of a third way, and went to Qingyun Temple to find Taoist Huo.
